Ḥolam before vav

Outside the divine name, the tables show all 17 occurrences in 16 verses of the selected MAM body text where a letter other than vav has a ḥolam dot and the next letter is vav. Combining marks may intervene. The tables group these occurrences by whether the vav carries a mark above it.

For the divine name, the tables show the first matching occurrence in book and verse order for each of two types, with and without an accent above the vav.

In the selected MAM body text, no vav with HOLAM HASER FOR VAV (U+05BA) has another vav as its next base letter, allowing intervening combining marks.

The blue text marks the letter carrying the ḥolam dot and the following vav. Each occurrence appears twice in its row, once with normal letter spacing and once with expanded letter spacing.
